checks.stage3_base_note: With the bridge's aggregate and every other mechanism applied, the base leaves every stage-1 investment row plus 4 eitc_eligible rows the full run does not have (tax units 27227, 52975, 85432, 95378): the all-members age rule makes Axiom eligible where PolicyEngine still denies on its own investment aggregate. They are counterfactual-only and are not attributed.

method: Each mechanism is one Axiom-side input change that makes Axiom see what PolicyEngine-US 1.729.0 sees; the PolicyEngine leg is fixed. Every combination of mechanisms re-runs the Axiom EITC surface over the affected tax units, and a row is attributed to the smallest set whose re-run clears it. Stage 1: age, partnership, investment (2^3 combinations). Stage 2, on stage 1's residual: se_loss, seca on top of all stage-1 mechanisms (2^2). Stage 3, on the investment rows: the five ways the two 32(i)(2) aggregates differ (2^5), with every other mechanism applied.
